title: cereus multangularis var. limensis
intro: Cereus multangularis var. limensis, commonly known as the "Lima Cereus," is a species of cactus native to the coastal regions of Peru. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Cereus multangularis var. limensis include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain, prevent infections, and protect against cell damage. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
